# Agent

<!-- GENERATED by tools/gen_component_agents.py from xrds/agent.meta.yaml; edit the sidecar, not this file. -->

The durable half of an Autopilot agent, as a pin: which commit of the agent definition in the app's own repository (agents/<name>.yaml) is live. Clearance lists these XRs, fetches each pinned file through the agents' GitHub App and loads it beside the platform's bundled definitions. The XR composes nothing and carries no definition content or credential; it is requested through the Autopilot templates in Backstage (New agent, Pin agent) into tenants/<app>/xr-requests/.

## How it is requested

Composed by other kinds; not requested directly.

## Conditions

Besides Crossplane's Ready and Synced. Reasons are a closed set:

- `AgentPinned`: `AgentPinned` (True).

## Verify a live XR

```
tools/airframe-verify agent <namespace>/<name> [--context CTX]
```

Read-only. Steps, after the implicit `xr-synced` check:

- `pinned` (condition): AgentPinned is True and status.commit is spec.source.commit.
- `commit-published` (xrField): status.commit equals the pinned commit.
- `loaded-by-clearance` (manual): clearance-api GET /v1/agents lists {name} with source.commit equal to spec.source.commit (and it is not in `rejected`). A pin Clearance could not load (file missing at that commit, schema error, name or owner mismatch, repository not the app's own) is listed under `rejected` with the reason; fix the file or the pin.

## Editing this composition

- Edit `compositions/agent/templates/`, never the inline blocks in `composition.yaml`: `python3 tools/build-compositions agent` splices them.
- `python3 tools/test_compositions.py --update agent` regenerates `example/expected/`; review that diff like code, it is the behaviour change.
- `python3 tools/test_sidecars.py` fails if a template change breaks a name this sidecar promises.
- Nothing is composed: the composition only writes status and AgentPinned. Ready=True means the pin is well-formed, not that Clearance loaded it; read clearance-api GET /v1/agents.
- A pin names a commit, never a branch. To move an agent to a new definition, re-pin (the Pin agent template): change spec.source.commit in tenants/<app>/xr-requests/<name>.yaml.
- The definition file's `name` must equal the XR's metadata.name and its `owner` must equal spec.owner, or Clearance rejects the pin (visible under `rejected`).
- spec.app is fixed at creation; the repository must be the app's own (<app>, gitops-<app>, gitops-infra-<app>): the broker refuses a read token for any other.

Contract: `tools/airframe-capabilities verify agent`; schema: `xrds/agent.yaml`.
